description: This file defines a CEL function library extension for regex utility functions, including 'find' and 'findAll' methods with regex compilation and optimization features.

classes.name: regex
classes.description: A struct providing regex functions for CEL, including 'find' and 'findAll', with associated compile and program options.

methods.name: Regex
methods.description: Returns a CEL environment option that registers the regex library functions.

methods.name: LibraryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the regex library.

methods.name: Types
methods.description: Returns the types supported by the regex library (empty in this case).

methods.name: declarations
methods.description: Returns the function declarations for 'find' and 'findAll'.

methods.name: CompileOptions
methods.description: Provides compile-time options, including regex function registration.

methods.name: ProgramOptions
methods.description: Provides runtime program options, including regex optimization.
